summary: One read of an account's provider events ended, with what it read and stored and the failure it ended with, if any.

read_id.description: The read, as every provider event it stored keeps it.

plugin.description: The plugin the account was read through.

binding_identity.description: The account's binding, as the sha256: of its canonical form, or none for a route that names no binding.

mode.description: Where the read started: the account's cursor, the store's depth back from now on a first read, after a gap or after a cursor the plugin forgot, or a span asked for again.

stored.description: Provider events stored for the first time.

duplicates.description: Provider events the store already held.

said.description: Lines said in campaigns from what was stored.

outcome.description: How the read ended; moved where another writer moved the cursor first and nothing of the page was kept.

code.description: The failure code of a failed read, or null.

class.description: The failure class of a failed read, or null.

plugin_version.description: The version of the plugin the read ran at.

plugin_digest.description: The content digest of the plugin package the read ran at.

plugin_snapshot_id.description: The plugin snapshot the read was pinned to.

routing_snapshot_id.description: The routing snapshot the read was pinned to.

signaled.description: Whether a signal brought the read forward.

backfill.description: The span asked for again that the read was of; absent for a read of the account's own cursor.

backfill_status.description: Where that span stands after the read.

anyOf.description: A read of the account from its own cursor or by date.
A read of a span asked for again.
